visualCharacteristics.purpose: Stacked collapsible FAQ panels with a plus/minus indicator; also emits FAQPage structured data
visualCharacteristics.description: 11 stacked light-grey (#efeff1 approx) rounded panels with question text and plus/minus icon on the right; answers contain paragraphs, lists, bold text and links.

contentPattern.structure: one row per item. Cell 1: question. Cell 2: answer (paragraphs, lists, bold, links). Icons in the question cell are dropped
contentPattern.source: One row per item: cell 1 question (summary text), cell 2 answer (paragraphs, lists, bold, links). Drop the plus/minus icon images.

usage: FAQ sections. Put the section heading as default content above the block.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any question/answer list. Use accordion-link-list for a single disclosure holding a link list.
